scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter web lint && uv run --directory services/api ruff check app tests && uv run --directory services/api ruff format --check app tests alembic
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter web typecheck && uv run --directory services/api mypy app
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter web test && uv run --directory services/api pytest -q
scripts.openapi:sync: uv run --directory services/api python -m app.export_openapi && openapi-typescript packages/api-types/openapi.json -o packages/api-types/src/schema.ts
